name: [otel demo] ad GetAds p95 under 20 ms (${ENV_NAME})
description: Share of minutes in which the ad service's per-minute p95 is under 20 ms, from the OTel-derived trace metric (computed from the ad service's OTLP spans). The adHighCpu windows (hourly :30 to :45 UTC, and stage.sh) burn it: each window is about 15 bad minutes. See DEMO-PLAN.md.
